subject: english
question:
**Convert the sentence provided below from its passive voice structure to an active voice structure:**

The machinery was known to have been operated manually during the testing phase.

options.text: Manual operators were known to test the machinery.
Someone was known to operate the machinery manually during testing.
It was known that the machinery had been manually tested.
It was known that someone manually operated the machinery during testing.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• Passive voice structure: The subject of the active voice sentence becomes the object of the passive voice sentence.
 
• The sentence in the active voice must clearly specify the subject performing the action.
 
• In the given sentence, "The machinery was known to have been operated manually during the testing phase," the active voice version shifts focus to the subject performing the action.
 
• The correct active voice version aligns with Option 4: "It was known that someone manually operated the machinery during testing."
 
• This version clearly states the action and maintains the original meaning of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.
 
**Correct Sentence:** *"It was known that someone manually operated the machinery during testing."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"Manual operators were known to test the machinery." – Incorrect as it changes the meaning of the sentence.
 
• **Option 2: **"Someone was known to operate the machinery manually during testing." – Incorrect as it does not align with the original sentence structure.
 
• **Option 3: **"It was known that the machinery had been manually tested." – Incorrect as it remains in passive voice.

47:T
